title: The simultaneous system clopen composite localizes to the intrinsic composite
statement: For any sequence C of commutative rings and homomorphisms τ:C(n+1)→C(n), and a commutative proper/open square k,r,p,i with k,i quasi-compact, the exact localization localizeSquare of VaryingRing.moduleAlpha is heterogeneously equal to SemilinearProperOpen.alpha. This equality is in the simultaneous derived module category before evaluation. Definitions and operations are those of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows], [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons], [def-sf-ambient-exact-clopen-data].

proof.text:
Identify the two ordinary direct images by their coefficient ring maps and use
adjoint uniqueness for their inverse images and open extensions. Their direct-image
compositors agree on every section, so their pullback compositors agree. Exact
localization preserves the inverse mate defining beta. The localized module projector
has composite with the canonical open-to-direct comparison equal to the proper unit;
this identifies it with the intrinsic projector. The normalized composite open
adjunction localizes to the composite exact open adjunction, fixing the open compositor.
Exact-derived transformation pasting now identifies the complete alpha words. Every
step occurs on the single sequence-site module category, before any evaluation.
